title.zh: 【Kraken 母公司 Payward 旗下 CF Benchmarks 推出预言机服务】
title.en: 【Kraken 母公司 Payward 旗下 CF Benchmarks 推出预言机服务】

current_state.zh: CF Benchmarks, owned by Kraken parent Payward, launched an oracle service that lets on-chain applications access its crypto, equities, bonds, commodities, and currency pricing data.
